propositions: Add a deterministic repository-rooted guard that scans for deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary and fails on unallowlisted matches, count drift, and malformed/duplicate/stale allowlist entries.
The guard uses a tab-delimited count-pinned allowlist (path/count/reason) so exemptions are non-vacuous and fail on both count increase and decrease.

Match Success Criteria/criterion case-insensitively repo-wide excluding archive, experiments, the minified editor.js vendor bundle, and cache/VCS dirs; match bare SC/SCs only under scoped reviewer, guide, and routing paths.
Wire the guard into the root Makefile lint target so local make lint and CI run the same check.
Migrate residual live prose in completion.py, its test, and the sample-ticket-log.jsonl from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria wording.
Preserve frozen migration evidence, Jira fixtures, negative-case probes, and the four O-RAN-SC ADR/workflow sites as byte-stable and outside the bare-token rule.
